_about: Keys. CS-mode keys only act while CS mode is on; in Minecraft mode every vanilla key behaves as usual. Attack/use/hotbar keys are taken over in CS mode, so nothing fires twice.

rows.action: shoot / knife slash / throw grenade (hold for automatic weapons)
knife stab, scope zoom on sniper/AUG/SG552
switch the weapon to the left / right hand (CS cl_righthand), remembered
inspect weapon (procedural twirl; CS 1.6 has no inspect animation)
buy one pack of primary ammo
buy one pack of pistol ammo
C4 when carrying it (CS slot 5), otherwise the previous weapon
hold on a planted C4 within 2.5 blocks for 10 s to defuse it
